# Barishamlai — Building Management System
# Full Content Index for LLMs

> Barishamlai is a SaaS building management platform for residential apartment buildings in Bangladesh. It streamlines rent collection, service charges, gas billing, expense management, and tenant communications. The platform supports bilingual (English/Bengali) operation.

---

## Public Pages

### Home (/)
Landing page introducing the platform with feature highlights: rent management, service charges, gas bills, financial reports, and multi-role access.

### Blog (/blog)
Educational articles on building management, tenant rights, and financial best practices.

### Blog Posts

#### What Is a Service Charge? (/blog/what-is-service-charge)
Explains the concept of service charges in residential buildings — shared costs for common area maintenance, security, cleaning, and utilities. Covers what is typically included, how it differs from rent, and why it is legally required to be itemized.

#### How to Calculate Service Charges (/blog/how-to-calculate-service-charge)
Step-by-step guide on calculating per-unit service charges. Covers area-based vs. flat-rate methods, occupied vs. vacant unit rates, and how to present charges transparently to tenants.

#### Tenant Rights Regarding Service Charges (/blog/tenant-rights-service-charge)
Overview of tenant rights when it comes to service charges in Bangladesh. Covers the right to itemized statements, disputing unreasonable charges, and what constitutes a valid service charge.

#### How to Manage Rent Collection (/blog/how-to-manage-rent-collection)
Best practices for collecting rent: setting due dates, handling late payments, keeping records, and using digital tools to reduce disputes and missed payments.

#### Digital Rent Receipts (/blog/digital-rent-receipts)
Why paper receipts are being replaced by digital records. Covers benefits (audit trails, searchability, automatic reminders), what a valid rent receipt must contain, and how Barishamlai generates them automatically.

#### Why Building Management Software Matters (/blog/why-building-management-software)
The case for moving from manual ledgers and spreadsheets to dedicated software. Covers common pain points (errors, lost records, disputes) and how software solves them for small and mid-size residential buildings.

### About (/about)
Background on the Barishamlai platform, its mission to modernize building management in Bangladesh, and the team behind it.

### Contact (/contact)
Contact form and support information for building owners, managers, and tenants.

### Privacy Policy (/privacy)
Describes what data is collected, how it is stored, and user rights under applicable law.

### Terms of Service (/terms)
Terms governing use of the Barishamlai platform, including acceptable use, payment terms, and liability limitations.

## Application Features (Dashboard — Private)

Access requires authentication. Available to registered buildings with appropriate role assignments.

### Roles
- **Admin**: Full access — billing, expenses, configuration, user management
- **President**: Read-only access to all financial and tenant data
- **Secretary**: Read-only access to all financial and tenant data
- **Tenant**: Access to their own bills and payment history

### Rent Module (/dashboard/rent)
- Per-unit monthly rent billing
- Payment tracking and due balance management
- Opening balance entry for migration from manual systems
- Bilingual receipt generation

### Service Charge Module (/dashboard/service-charge)
- Per-unit service charge billing (different rates for occupied vs. vacant units)
- Service Charge Fund balance tracking (opening balance + collected - expenses)
- Expense categories: Security Guard Salary, Caretaker Salary, Cleaner Salary, Lift Servicing, Common Electricity, Generator, Maintenance
- Opening balance entry for fund migration

### Gas Bill Module (/dashboard/gas)
- Per-unit gas consumption billing based on unit rate
- Gas Fund balance tracking (opening balance + collected - expenses)
- Gas Cylinder Purchase expense tracking
- Opening balance entry for fund migration

### General Expenses (/dashboard/expenses)
- Non-fund expenses not related to service charge or gas
- Category-based tracking

### Units & Tenants (/dashboard/units)
- Unit inventory management (floor, number, area)
- Tenant assignment per unit
- Per-unit opening due balances for each bill type (rent, service charge, gas)

### Reports (/dashboard/reports)
- Fund summaries: opening balance + collected - expenses = current balance
- Per-unit payment history
- Monthly billing summaries

### Configuration (/dashboard/config)
- Building-level rate settings (rent, service charge rates, gas unit rate)
- Module toggles: enable/disable Rent, Service Charge, and Gas modules
- Disabled modules are hidden from the sidebar

### Onboarding Wizard (/dashboard/onboarding)
- Step 1: Select which modules to enable
- Step 2: Enter opening balances for each fund (service charge fund, gas fund)
- Step 3: Enter per-unit opening due/advance balances for each bill type
- Designed for easy migration from manual systems or spreadsheets

---

## Technical Details

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js with JWT sessions
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant (one building = one workspace)
- **Languages**: English and Bengali (বাংলা)
- **Hosting**: Vercel
